name: Hyundai Corporation
summary: Hyundai Corporation operates as an import and export trading company in the Republic of Korea, the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company distributes hot and cold rolled steel products, rear panels, coated steel sheets, steel pipes, bar and section steel, and stainless steel; aluminum, zinc, slabs, billets, blank coins, and bank note papers; gasoline, diesel oil, aircraft fuel, and sea bunkering, as well as olefin, aroma, synthetic resins, raw materials, and chemical fertilizers; and passenger and commercial vehicles, special and military vehicles, engines, and automobile parts.
